item.title: Cindy Holscher Wins Kansas Democratic Primary for Governor

item.title: Arizona’s Democratic Governor Set to Pick a Republican Running Mate

item.title: Missouri Voters Reject Measure to Limit Their Ballot Box Powers
item.description: The state’s conservative Legislature had put the measure on the ballot that would have enacted citizen initiatives only if they won majorities in each of Missouri’s eight U.S. House districts.
item.dc:creator: Kate Zernike
item.media:credit: Ed Zurga/Associated Press
item.media:description: Residents place their signatures on a petition in support of a ballot initiative to end Missouri’s near-total ban on abortion during a petition drive in Kansas City in 2024.

item.title: Kansas Voters Crush a Measure to Elect Supreme Court Judges
item.description: The rejection of a measure to begin electing justices was a victory for abortion rights groups who defended the Kansas high court’s ruling that abortion was protected in the state constitution.
item.dc:creator: Kate Zernike
item.media:credit: Charlie Riedel/Associated Press
item.media:description: The Kansas Supreme Court hearing a case in Topeka, Kan., in 2019.

item.title: Wesley Bell Defeats Cori Bush in Missouri

item.media:description: Representative Wesley Bell, Democrat of Missouri, withstood a primary challenge from former Representative Cori Bush, his predecessor, on Tuesday.

item.title: Pastor Adam Hamilton Wins Kansas Democratic Senate Primary
item.description: The Rev. Adam Hamilton will be a serious underdog against Roger Marshall, a Republican, but Democrats think the state could be competitive if the November environment is favorable enough to them.

item.media:description: Adam Hamilton, a Methodist megachurch pastor from Kansas, speaks to voters as he wraps up a U.S. Senate listening tour at Limitless Brewing in Lenexa, Kan. in April.

item.title: Armed Man Arrested at Trump Golf Club Near Los Angeles

item.media:description: Trump National Golf Club Los Angeles in June. The president was scheduled to speak at the club on Tuesday night.

item.title: What One Witness Saw Before a Spokane Wildfire Started
item.description: A resident of Spokane County, Wash., said he noticed a man acting suspiciously and called 911 after seeing smoke. The police later arrested a suspect tied to one of the wildfires in the area.
item.dc:creator: Pooja Salhotra and Anna Griffin
item.media:credit: Loren Elliott for The New York Times
item.media:description: Paul Child at his home on the outskirts of Spokane on Tuesday. “I ran out the door,” said Mr. Child, 64, who suspected that the man he had seen had started a fire.
